title: The open identity generator commutes with arbitrary scheme pullback
statement:
Let $g:Y\to X$ be a scheme morphism and $W\subseteq X$ an open. Write $W'=g^{-1}W$, $j:W\to X$, $j':W'\to Y$ and $t:W'\to W$ for the restricted morphism. Let $A_W$ and $u_W:\mathbf Z_W\to j^*A_W$ be the free sheaf and its identity-generator map [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-object-cohomology-map]. Let $k:A_{W'}\to g^*A_W$ be the explicit section-classifying map [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-free-sheaf-pullback]. Use the exact inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Put $h=j'\gg g$ in Lean's composition order, and let $e_1:h^*\cong t^*\circ j^*$ and $e_2:h^*\cong j'^*\circ g^*$ be the canonical composition comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition], with the equality $t\gg j=j'\gg g$. Let $c_t:\mathbf Z_{W'}\to t^*\mathbf Z_W$ be the inverse constant-sheaf pullback comparison. Then, in Lean's left-to-right composition order,
$$u_{W'}\gg j'^*k=c_t\gg t^*u_W\gg (e_1^{-1}\gg e_2)_{A_W}.$$
This is an equality of sheaf morphisms, without a coefficient sheaf, Ext degree, Ext class, resolution or cocycle.

source.place: Tag 03F3 (localization); step 2 of lem-weil-pbc-etale-open-object-cohomology-pullback. The precise generator equality is agent-written, using constantSection_adjunct_pullback and open_restriction_pullback_unit, not stated verbatim in Stacks.

proof.text: Apply the constant-sheaf adjunction at mk(id of W') and the integer-generator equivalence. Both are injective, so it suffices to equate the classified sections. On the left, naturality of this adjunction makes the section j'^*k applied to the identity generator. Naturality of the inverse-image/localization comparison identifies this with restriction to W' of the section classified by k. The free-abelian sheaf/Yoneda adjunction and its inverse cancellation expand this section to the adjunction unit eta_g applied to the identity section of A_W, then restriction along openSectionPullback. Naturality in the sheafification map identifies the identity section used here with the one defining u_W. The generator evaluation is the existing proved private lemma AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.sectionsEquiv_generator in Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleResolutionSectionCanonicalWholeToOpen, accessed by a proof-only import all. Only that helper is used, not the whole-to-open comparison theorem; it computes the free-abelian sheaf/Yoneda adjunction from the comparison definitions already cited in this step.

On the right, constantSection_adjunct_pullback says that c_t followed by t^*u_W classifies the section of j^*A_W defining u_W, first sent through eta_t and then restricted along the terminal pullback identification. Postcomposition by e_1.inv followed by e_2.hom transports this section to j'^*g^*A_W. Evaluate open_restriction_pullback_unit at A_W and at that identity section. Its two sides are exactly this transported section and the unit eta_g section computed in step 1, after the localization comparisons. The displayed comparisons use a common composite h; transport the other version of the composition comparison along t >> j = j' >> g by equality elimination. The identity maps identifying mk(id >> j) with mk(j) cancel. Thus the two sections agree, and the two adjunction bijections prove the morphism equality. Terminal objects and all these comparisons exist for the empty open as well; no nonemptiness is used.
